description: This file contains utility functions for handling subagent run records, including resolving labels, formatting labels and statuses, sorting runs, and resolving subagent targets based on various criteria.

methods.name: resolveSubagentLabel
methods.description: Returns a label for a subagent run record, using label or task fields, with a fallback default.

methods.name: formatRunLabel
methods.description: Formats a subagent run label, sanitizing and truncating it based on options.

methods.name: formatRunStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of a subagent run, indicating 'running' if not ended, or 'done'/'ok' otherwise.

methods.name: sortSubagentRuns
methods.description: Sorts an array of subagent run records by their start or creation time in descending order.

methods.name: resolveSubagentTargetFromRuns
methods.description: Resolves a subagent target from a list of runs based on token, label, session key, index, or status.
